final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response is mainly a reframing and narrowing of the claim: it concedes there is no evidence of pre-launch disclosure, no approved risk acceptance, and no final legal determination. That narrowing is useful but it does not convert the record into compliant or compliant_with_caveats status. A caveat can support compliant_with_caveats when it bounds a residual risk within an otherwise satisfied policy path; here the caveat identifies an unresolved policy predicate that the record still does not satisfy. Aggregate readiness and clean rehearsal results support general launch health, and public governance guidance supports documenting limitations and monitoring, but neither substitutes for the internal requirement that a material limitation affecting a named/protected launch segment be resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. Because that predicate remains unresolved on the admissible record, escalation remains warranted.
